name: Zenith
description: A quiet, minimal look for Zen: six areas (Core, Edges, Tabs, URL bar, Panels, Motion) plus Zenith Plus (Peek, live edges, timers and more). Settings are grouped by area.
author: bootzin

plus/scripts/zenith-plus.uc.mjs.name: Zenith Plus
plus/scripts/zenith-plus.uc.mjs.description: Live edges, minimap, zoom pills, page colours, sidebar colour, motion, Ctrl numbers.

plus/scripts/zenith-peek.uc.mjs.name: Peek
plus/scripts/zenith-peek.uc.mjs.description: Quick, disposable lookups in a floating Glance.

plus/scripts/zenith-timers.uc.mjs.name: Timers
plus/scripts/zenith-timers.uc.mjs.description: Countdowns and pomodoros started from Peek, on the page edge.

plus/scripts/zenith-switcher.uc.mjs.name: Switcher
plus/scripts/zenith-switcher.uc.mjs.description: Jump to any tab, folder or space by typing (Alt+W); : runs commands.

plus/scripts/zenith-bookmarks.uc.mjs.name: Bookmarks
plus/scripts/zenith-bookmarks.uc.mjs.description: Your bookmarks in Zenith's look (Ctrl+B), beside the page or in Zen's Library.

plus/scripts/zenith-ai.uc.mjs.name: Local AI
plus/scripts/zenith-ai.uc.mjs.description: Firefox's own on-device AI: clearer download names, tab groups by topic. Nothing leaves your computer.

plus/scripts/zenith-tabs.uc.mjs.name: Tab manager
plus/scripts/zenith-tabs.uc.mjs.description: Every tab at a glance, and tidying up: duplicates, unused and awake tabs, busy sites (Alt+Shift+T).

plus/scripts/zenith-settings.uc.mjs.name: Settings helper
plus/scripts/zenith-settings.uc.mjs.description: Greys out Zenith settings that don't apply, and says why.

plus/scripts/zenith-settings-page.uc.mjs.name: Settings page and live panel
plus/scripts/zenith-settings-page.uc.mjs.description: The Zenith page in Zen's Settings, and the live panel (Alt+Shift+Z).
